test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of the assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

"In order to retain employees, we must reward them with monthly benefits", company chairman tells the manager.

**Assumptions:**

I. Monthly benefits will keep the employees happy.

II. The employees will be punctual.

options.text: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit
Both assumptions I and II are implicit

solution:
I. Monthly benefits will keep the employees happy.

Only assumption I is implicit as it is clearly stated in the question that In order to retain employees, we must reward them with monthly benefits.

II. The employees will be punctual.

Assumption II is not implicit as there is no statement regarding the punctuality of employees.

Hence, **o****nly assumption I is implicit**.
